overview_text: This combined major is designed to educate students in psychology and music and the interface between the two disciplines. The scope and sequence of psychology courses provide students with a foundation in the interdisciplinary science of psychology including cognition, psycholinguistics, perception, and the biological basis of behavior. Music courses provide a foundation in music theory, creative music in context, contemporary/ethnomusicology, music perception and cognition, and the psychoacoustics of music. The program fosters understanding how the two fields jointly contribute to explaining human behavior in the domain of music.
